supersededBeforeCompletion.reason: Critical key-priority estimate was revised after a public stored-resource change.

failedAttempts.category: Existing wrong-ticket transport watchdog fixture, two-second recovery wait

design.unit: One family, ordered deck pair and seed crossed with both seats and first players. Family bootstrap uses complete clean units. Aggregate point estimate only.

scope.directDiscardSelection: Accepted Select of a physical card in the observer’s own visible hand at an own direct target-operation/discard prompt. Intermediate selections count. Active-house membership and public Scrap presence partition the events. Effect-selection is reported separately without inferring the continuation.
scope.refillSlot: A 0.9 slot is a marginally available draw capped by public deck plus discard supply. A reshuffle can return the just-discarded physical card; no probability of a different identity is estimated.
limitations: Previously seen fixed deck collection and two held-out confirmation seeds. Decks recur across units.
Selections are descriptive. Optional and mandatory prompts are both eligible. An accepted selection does not demonstrate movement, current playability or Scrap resolution.
The bundled comparison cannot attribute a win-rate change to one helper; no online strength estimate.

staticDeckCoverage.scope: Literal static shapes in deck definitions and composition. A counted slot or plausible partner does not establish an in-game trigger, payable move, granted play or realized score.

replay.boundary: Same actual policy family, same candidate-seat public observation. Recorded accepted command compared to two raw rankings before loop guard. Alternate ranking does not replay alternative outcomes.

coverageDiagnostic.scope: A fixed two-deck sample selected for literal feature gaps without inspecting interim scores. All eight results are coverage diagnostics. Candidate-seat observations and accepted plays do not measure causal pool gain or win-rate benefit. No extra sample is assigned for replay.

traceDiagnostics.boundary: Same actual policy family, same candidate-seat public observation. Recorded accepted command compared to two raw rankings before loop guard. Alternate ranking does not replay alternative outcomes.

postHocNativeDiscardReview.selection: Earliest two confirmation game IDs per family containing an accepted candidate-seat native discard of a playable card without visible Scrap. All matching events in those four games. Outcome-independent, encounter-enriched post-hoc subset.
